name: Berason
description: Berason was a Mid Rim mining world located in the Eclorar sector. During the Galactic Civil War, Berason—the inhabitants of which politically opposed the Galactic Empire—was subjected to an Imperial blockade that cut off the world's sources of food and medical supplies. Eventually, a Rebel Alliance force led by Airen Cracken ran the blockade, performing a strike against Berason's Imperial base and paving way for an Alliance convoy to bring supplies to the world.
